scope: Current main-board finishing register. Supported connections and completed measurements are recorded in the current model; resolved issues are archived. Remaining hidden paths, candidate identities, values and operating behavior are listed below.

rails.name: BATTERY+
rails.path: Actual positive battery terminal -> Q1 single pad/native3 (candidate drain). TP14 is OUTA, separate from this rail.
rails.basis: User battery-path report. TP14-U5.8 measured 1.5 ohm; BP-TP14 measured 6.3 V, rejecting the former battery-side photo assignment.

rails.name: VSYS
rails.board_label: No printed net name; user-approved name
rails.path: Q1.L/native2 -> U5/MX512H pin4; L1.1 and L2.1 supply sides.
rails.basis: User-confirmed shared supply; filter terminal numbering is photo-derived. Do not join their opposite ends.

rails.name: VDD
rails.path: TP103, PIC20/C32, U5 pin1/VCC, V064/V063/V075/V082. D3.R via V082 is user-confirmed.
rails.basis: User via/test-point continuity. Distinct from VSYS and BATTERY+.

rails.name: VREF
rails.path: TP104, PIC4/RA2/V035/C39, R21.2/V071. U3.5 and R22 D/left/model2 at 1 ohm.
rails.basis: User-confirmed core plus U3.5/R22 D/left. R48.2 removed: user annotation groups it with R25/R47/C42; R23 branch rejected. PIC21/RB0/V026 explicitly withdrawn; TP16-VREF measured 800 kohm.

rails.name: GND
rails.basis: User ground reports and matched rear copper; association of every candidate branch is not thereby proved.

issues.known: C5/C6 parallel wiring and Q8 ground/output joins are established. B37 P-F = 1 ohm supports Q8.T2/native2 to C6.1 on H_RF_VDD; no fresh baseline or stability statement supplied. SIL3724A and the U2 inverter remain candidates. B54/B55 measured VSYS and RF supply at 6.3 V in the red-blinking bench state.
issues.unknown: Candidate gate/source roles, P-channel turn-off margin and RF timing remain unverified. The source-supply continuity question no longer requires a bench check.
issues.next_action: Later operating check on the original hardware: establish source/gate voltages and actual gate-to-source drive, then RF timing if suitable equipment is available. Do not repeat P-F continuity.
issues.closed_when: Source path and actual gate-to-source drive are supported; C6 value is handled by V01.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.known: PIC-to-control resistors and local tuning midpoints are mapped. B44/B45 midpoint-to-antenna DC readings are OL. B52 C11 outer end to ANT2 = 1.4 ohm; photo-shared outer pads of C14/C29/C44/C47 now join ANT2. Rear capacitor returns remain GND. ANT1-ANT2 is about 5 ohm with antenna fitted. The mistaken 414 kohm N-B report was corrected to B-G. Q3 L-S latest 0.48 V, L-R 2.3 V; all other diode directions OL.
issues.unknown: The drawn PNP B=R/E=L/C=S candidate is still not confirmed by in-circuit junction readings. Capacitor values and actual switching/resonance behavior remain unknown. The front capacitor-bank antenna connection is now established.
issues.next_action: No more antenna continuity sweep. Leave Q3 fitted as requested. Agent reviews candidate device roles against the corrected topology; isolate-device identification is deferred. RF operating checks follow only after values and suitable instrumentation are addressed.
issues.closed_when: Tuning device pin roles and switched RF behavior are supported; outer ANT2 path is already resolved.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.area: PIC test branches: TP11 and TP17
issues.known: PIC14/RC3 reaches TP11; PIC18/RC7 reaches TP17. Front/rear photos show no onward surface trace at those test points. Both are valid endpoints, not dangling wires. RA0/C25 to TP6 measured 1.5 ohm in B59 and is now resolved on RX_A_FILTER.
issues.unknown: Only the possibility of additional inner-layer connections on RC3/TP11 and RC7/TP17 remains. A test-only purpose is plausible but not established by photographs.
issues.next_action: No justified new continuity pair is identified. Retain the two known PIC-to-test-point routes and the explicit inner-layer limitation; do not repeat TP16-to-TP11/TP17. Continue the prepared supply-voltage batch for the operating issues.
issues.closed_when: Additional continuation is traced, or physical layer evidence establishes these are test-only branches. Until then, reproduce the known local routes without asserting that hidden continuations are absent.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.area: PIR: Q2 behavior and operating supply
issues.known: J3/U7 ordering, U6 external pads and PIC21/TP16/Q2 output routing are established. U6 pin5 is tied to VIN; pin4 is unused. B58 measured 3.3 V at J3.1 with PIR connected; logic VDD was 4.5 V.
issues.unknown: Q2 terminal functions, PIR raw-signal behavior and PIC input response remain unverified. The loaded PIR supply is established at 3.3 V in the reported state; transients and other states are not characterized.
issues.next_action: After the receiver supply check, compare J3.2 raw signal and TP16/PIC21 as PIR state changes. Do not repeat the 3.3 V baseline or established connector continuity.
issues.closed_when: Q2 signal behavior and U6 output are supported by device or operating evidence.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.known: U3 input returns and R23/R42/C40, C23/R25/R48 and DNP R47/C42 paths are reconciled. VREF supplies U3 pin5. B59 C25.1-TP6.1 = 1.5 ohm establishes the receiver filter connection to PIC2/RA0; R27 remains between that node and U3.1. B57 measured the printed VREF test point at 0 V while the red LED blinked about once per second.
issues.unknown: Q7 transistor pin roles/supply switching, receiver gain/filter response and the functional MCU interface are unverified. H_RX_DETECT is only a series junction, not proof of a missing output wire. D3/R42-to-PIC25/RB4 wiring is established; its functional role belongs to receiver/Q1 operating validation, not an assumed missing wire. VREF at 0 V must be interpreted against PIC/receiver state; receiver supply and amplifier output voltages remain unmeasured.
issues.next_action: B62: red TP5 receiver-supply test point to black GND, DC volts in the same red-blinking state. This distinguishes absent receiver supply from a bias-path issue; no baseline rail repeats.
issues.closed_when: Receiver supply, bias and the existing RA0/RA1/RB4 interfaces have supported operating roles; no presumed extra output wire is required.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.known: VSYS/RF 6.3 V, printed VDD 4.5 V, PIR supply 3.3 V with PIR attached; VREF 0 V and red LED approximately 1 Hz. TP14 is now established on U5.8/OUTA at 1.5 ohm; R43.2/V015 follows its existing TP14 association. BATTERY+ stays separate. TP14-Q1 gate measured 516 ohm.
issues.unknown: Q1 control behavior, motor-output states, the path giving 516 ohm from OUTA to Q1 gate, zero VREF and the red-flashing state remain unresolved. R3/R4/C28-to-RB3 functional role is inferred.
issues.next_action: First B62: TP5 receiver supply to GND in the same powered state. Then choose operating-state checks for Q1 and the bridge, using the corrected TP14/OUTA assignment; no repeat continuity requested.
issues.closed_when: Actual supply levels and control behavior are recorded without merging battery, VSYS or filtered branches.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.known: D6 anode is GND and cathode is VPP; forward drop is about 0.7V and reverse diode mode is OL. J1 pin order is resolved. Primary programming specification DS40001753B requires 8.0-9.0 V for high-voltage entry; low-voltage entry exists only when LVP is enabled.
issues.unknown: G3 is nonunique: MMSZ5228BS is 3.9 V; PZU2.4B is 2.4 V. Neither rating has been measured on this board. A directly connected clamp of either rating would load the required high-voltage ICSP level. The current PIC LVP configuration and actual D6 breakdown are unknown.
issues.next_action: No repeated continuity or diode-mode check. Marking research establishes ambiguity, not a rating. Keep D6 fitted for now; resolve its rating by an isolated current-limited test only if needed. Before any programmer session, establish the supported entry method; do not apply a breakdown test through the PIC.
issues.closed_when: Clamp class/rating is established or explicitly bounded for reconstruction, and programming compatibility is checked.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.area: Candidate device identities and pin roles
issues.known: Manufacturer candidate datasheets and pin tables exist. D2 local wiring is complete; measured R -> S -> L diode behavior supports a series pair.
issues.unknown: Exact fitted identity/ratings remain candidates for D1-D6, Q1-Q8/Q11, U1/U2/U6. The 4P marking alone does not identify three-pin D2; a manufacturer 4P code for a two-pin diode is incompatible.
issues.next_action: Resolve electrical risks through E03/E04/E07/E08/E09/E10. For remaining ambiguity retain the supported equivalent circuit and disclose ratings not established; no sharper-marking request or repeat D2 rail sweep. Exact manufacturer recovery is not always possible with a meter.
issues.closed_when: Each part has a supported pin/function model and adequate ratings or an explicit accepted-equivalent limitation; exact branding is not falsely claimed.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.known: C5 is 470uF/16V. L1/L2 readings are 1.4/2.2uH. Retained marked resistor nominal values are recorded.
issues.unknown: 44 fitted ceramic values remain unknown. L1/L2 measurement conditions and component ratings are not established.
issues.next_action: After tuning topology, prioritize antenna/RF/receiver capacitors with the LCR meter. Record frequency, mode and isolation. Parallel parts give a combined reading; lift one terminal only where an individual value is needed. Report existing L1/L2 measurement conditions without remeasuring yet.
issues.closed_when: Critical individual values are recovered; any bypass substitutions and unverified ratings are explicitly identified assumptions.
issues.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

issues.known: LED1 is the only unassigned footprint; R30/PIC23 lights red and R31/PIC22 lights green. C5 diameter/height, S1 body/actuator size, R8 and C11 sizes are already measured. J5 rear placement and both board contacts are mapped to U5 outputs from front/rear photos.
issues.unknown: LED1 land pattern/manufacturer numbering and internal pairing of its externally grounded cathode pads remain unverified. C5 pitch and S1 pad fit/3D heights are reproduction qualifications, not unknown schematic wires. J5 stock-footprint pad order/pitch and external motor harness colours remain unverified.
issues.next_action: Obtain LED underside/pad geometry or a matching vendor drawing before selecting a footprint. For later PCB reproduction check C5 lead pitch and S1 pad fit; use actual 16mm capacitor and 6mm switch heights. Do not repeat body dimensions. Match J5 physical A/B contacts to the chosen connector drawing before PCB layout; record harness colours when available, without repeating visible board continuity.
issues.closed_when: LED footprint has a supported pad map; remaining package-fit assumptions are documented separately from schematic connectivity.

photo_supported_summary: v0.9.18: C6 is reconstructed in parallel with C5 from the user proposal and photos IMG_2431/IMG_2432. C6 upper pad/model1 joins the C5-positive supply copper (H_RF_VDD, after L1); lower pad/model2 joins GND. Photo-supported, not a new meter-confirmed connection. C6 capacitance remains unknown. Earlier 400 kohm output exclusion and 10 ohm Q8-supply-path reading are retained; the latter does not independently prove Q8 source wiring.

v0.9.19 user annotated local copper: R47 left -> U3.1/R27 right; R47 right + C42 lower + R25 lower + R48 right share RX_STAGE_LINK. C42 upper -> GND inferred from continuous copper beside U3.4 in IMG_2429/2434. R25-GND and R48-VREF old assumptions withdrawn. R47/C42 remain DNP. No meter reading supplied.

v0.9.21 annotated photo: J6 left/model1 joins Q9 single/native3 and R36 right/model2. J6 right/model2 joins R36 left/model1. PIC26/RB5-TP10-R35 upper; R35 lower-Q9 paired-left; paired-right via V021 is GND. All J6/Q9/R35/R36 options remain DNP. R36 left/J6 right onward rail is not established by this annotation.

v0.9.21 user annotated S1 upper-right to C35 upper/model2 (GND via prior V018); lower-right to C35 lower/model1, R40 lower/model2 and R41 left/model2. User explicitly confirms R41 right/model1 reaches J1 VPP/MCLR. Correct physical-to-native switch mapping TL=1, TR=3, BL=2, BR=4. Top-row/bottom-row common pairs remain a tactile-switch hypothesis; released/pressed behavior has not been measured.

v0.9.22 user annotated U6A option: single left pad/model L/native U106.1 joins U6 pin5 and the existing input node after R37; upper-right/model R1/native2 joins J3.1 (red PIR wire); lower-right/model R2/native3 joins GND. All three external pads mapped, option remains DNP. User called the input VDD; retain VDD -> R37 (22 ohm) -> H_AUX_IN because the annotation ends at U6 pin5 and prior B28 confirms pin5-pin2, not a bypass across R37. No fitted IC identity or voltage measurement implied.

User measured a 6 x 6 x 4 mm body plus 2 mm actuator (about 6 mm overall). Photo shows four SMD gullwing leads; approximate pad-centre span from photo/body ratio is about 8 mm, consistent with the stock PTS645 land pattern (7.96 x 4.50 mm centres). Dimensions select a candidate family, not an exact manufacturer. Library x43 footprint/3D model denotes 4.3 mm overall and must not be used as the measured 6 mm housing.
